title: Elucidating the O2 reduction reaction on 2D monolayer LaMnO3 perovskite
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01470K, Paper
Naveen Sharma, Srimanta Pakhira
The present study demonstrates that the 2D LaMnO3 perovskite material is an excellent and highly efficient Pt-free cathode catalyst for ORR indicating the foundation for future technology applications.
